items.headline: Manchester United sign second wonderkid from Manchester City this week
items.summary: 16-year-old midfielder David Eze completed transfer from Manchester City on September 26, following Karim Cassim's arrival on September 24.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes carries 'complicated injury' from Portugal duty
items.summary: Manchester United captain suffered injury in Portugal vs Wales match and ruled out of remaining Nations League fixtures, raising fitness concerns.

items.headline: Patrick Dorgu returns from Denmark duty with hamstring injury
items.summary: Manchester United midfielder suffered hamstring injury during Denmark's Nations League fixture, adding to mounting injury crisis.

items.headline: Manchester United scouting Club Brugge defender as Luke Shaw successor
items.summary: Manager Michael Carrick identified Joaquin Seys as transfer target to replace Luke Shaw in defensive refresh planned for next year.

items.headline: Manchester United sign striker Isaac Konde from Liverpool
items.summary: Manchester United completed signing of England forward Isaac Konde from Liverpool on September 28 on undisclosed terms.

items.headline: Multiple injuries plague Manchester United during international break
items.summary: Six injury concerns during international break including Kobbie Mainoo, Marcus Rashford, and Noussair Mazraoui holding his back.
